text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock E and D at gains, then buying them again, reminds me to make trades for forward-looking reasons—not for the satisfaction of locking in gains or to avoid admitting a mistake.","My record gives no evidence that past price changes predict future ones. I should focus on diversification, risk, and my plan rather than price history or average cost.","Doing nothing has been reasonable when there was no compelling reason to trade. I should review whether my portfolio still fits my goals and hold when it does."]}
